title: Mercor — Generalist Expert (US/Canada) | $50–70/hr remote
copy:
Application positioning notes — review before entering into Mercor:

Justice Gray Maciocha / 1JGM — RegenExcalibur
Alberta, Canada

I am applying as a multidisciplinary generalist with a combination of hands-on construction/field experience and AI-assisted research, technical documentation, quality assurance, workflow design, and project coordination. My strongest fit is evaluating professional work products for accuracy, clarity, completeness, internal consistency, evidence quality, instruction-following, and practical usability.

Relevant experience includes creating and reviewing structured reports, technical specifications, PRDs, SOPs, checklists, research briefs, evidence registers, risk/decision logs, spreadsheets, comparison matrices, QA rubrics, test plans, and AI-generated technical outputs. I regularly decompose ambiguous problems into requirements, workstreams, acceptance criteria, evidence needs, edge cases, and review gates.

Through RegenExcalibur I use AI systems as research and productivity tools across technical, construction, software, clean-tech, business, and multidisciplinary problems while preserving human verification and clearly separating verified facts, assumptions, inference, and unknowns.

I also bring approximately eight years of construction and field operations experience, including residential framing across 80+ homes, foundation formwork, materials/logistics, junior HDD/utilities support, landscaping/property work, measurement, sequencing, quality control, and practical troubleshooting. This gives me a grounded perspective when judging whether instructions and professional outputs are actually usable rather than merely well-written.

I am comfortable reviewing documents, presentations, spreadsheets, research outputs, structured data, and AI-generated responses against defined criteria and explaining errors or improvement opportunities in clear written English.

I am seeking remote, asynchronous contract work and can work independently against defined quality standards and deadlines.

Portfolio: https://github.com/Lornt1666/RegenExcalibur/blob/main/FREELANCE_PROFILE.md

Accuracy note: I do not claim credentials or degrees I do not possess. Where an application asks about education, employment dates, identity, work authorization, assessments, agreements, or other personal declarations, I will answer those fields personally and truthfully.
